title: Musical
summary: MU'SICAL, adjective Belonging to music; as musical proportion; a musical instrument. 1. Producing music or agreeable sounds; as a musical voice. 2. Melodious; harmonious; pleasing to the ear; as music

inlines.v: MU'SICAL, adjective Belonging to music; as musical proportion; a musical instrument. 1. Producing music or agreeable sounds; as a musical voice. 2. Melodious; harmonious; pleasing to the ear; as musical sounds or numbers.
